label: D1 late in episode after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, rewarded)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 1, and only late in the episode (ep_trial >= 60; rate rises steeply toward trials 90-99). Strongest and most precise when the previous trial was a1 leading rarely to S2 and rewarded (the rare-rewarded pattern that should trigger a switch to a2). That predicate gets dev P 0.64 / R 0.58 / mass recall 0.80; the misses are mostly weak activations on other rewarded D1 steps after a1 (common a1->S1 rewarded), plus a little after a2. It never fires after an unrewarded trial, at GO or D2, or before trial ~60. Magnitude goes up later in the episode (restricting to ep_trial >= 80 gives precision 0.89 and covers most of the top quartile) and when the value-head output is low (value < 5.22 gives precision 0.91). All variables are observed at D1 (previous trial outcome, previous choice and state, and elapsed time), so no future variables are used.
